purpose: Byte ceilings for every path in config/canonical-read-manifest.json, enforced by tools/check_canon_budget.py. These are TARGETS, not descriptions: the gate is expected to be RED until the canon has been cut down to them. Raising a number to fit the text is the failure this file exists to prevent — the read manifest reached 1917 KB one honest paragraph at a time, and every gate before this one could only be satisfied by adding.
how_to_use: Over a ceiling? Move the history to docs/archive/ and leave the live statement behind. A canonical file answers 'what is true now'; an archive answers 'how did we get here'. The second question is real and its answer does not belong in a set every session must read before it can start.
total_bytes_note: About 70k tokens. The canon is pasted into a session at SessionStart, so it competes for the same context the work needs. At 1917 KB the hook could deliver a quarter of it and listed the rest under a NOT PASTED banner — a read that silently did not happen. The sum of per_file_bytes is held at or under this number so the two constraints cannot disagree.
max_shared_fraction_note: Measured over lines of 40+ characters, against the SMALLER of the two files. NEXT_CHAT.md and PROJECT_STATE.md currently share 3037 consecutive identical lines from line 2 and differ only in their titles; TASKS.md is 92% contained in NEXT_CHAT.md. No per-file ceiling would have caught that — each of the three reads as a single long document on its own.

rationale.NEXT_CHAT.md: A handoff is the current branch, PR, HEAD, blockers and next action. It is at 321 KB / 4034 lines because every session appended its write-up and none removed one; its own line 9 says 'Earlier prose below is HISTORY'.
rationale.PROJECT_STATE.md: Currently a byte-for-byte copy of NEXT_CHAT.md under a different title. The ceiling assumes it either states something NEXT_CHAT does not, or stops being canonical.
rationale.TASKS.md: A coordination board is the open tasks and who holds them. Closed-task narrative is archive.
rationale.MASTER_EXECUTION_ROADMAP.md: The durable product plan legitimately needs room — 11 phases with per-phase gates. Not room for per-task narrative, which belongs to the task.
rationale.config/current_state.json: 110 KB, of which the `purpose` field alone is 74,311 characters of prose — inside the file called the machine-readable mirror, whose own first sentence says not to read a commit id out of that sentence.
rationale.apps/desktop/AUDIT/AUDIT_LEDGER.md: The audit POSITION — the standing verdict and the open rows — is what a session must have. Nine rounds of per-finding narrative is the record, and the record can be a linked file.
rationale.docs/design/WAVE_3B_ISOLATED_SIGNER_DESI: 44 KB of normative contract, not narrative, and it has not grown. Its ceiling was set to 36000 by the session that wrote this file, from a guess rather than a reading; the file is 43,943 bytes of specification. Raised to 44000 and recorded here, because 'the remedy is never a bigger number' is about text that GREW, not about a ceiling that was wrong when it was written -- and the difference has to be stated or the rule becomes unfalsifiable. It stays in the read set because check_coordination.ACTIVE_WAVE_DOCS pins it there while it exists on disk; the other three design documents left the set instead.
rationale.config/owner-contract.md: Injected into EVERY message by the prompt hook, so it competes with the work on every turn. A ceiling of 4000 keeps it short enough to actually be read each time; a communication contract nobody finishes reading is not enforced either.

state_fields_read_by_nothing_note: Fields of config/current_state.json that no tool, hook, workflow or module reads, each with the reason it is kept anyway. tools/check_state_fields.py refuses an undeclared unread field AND an entry for a field something has started reading. Ninth audit I-06: check_repo_state.py verifies settled_at_main_head and prs[] against live GitHub and never the rest, which is how `purpose` reached 74,311 characters -- a field nothing reads cannot be wrong, so nothing corrects it.
